part.text:
Done. Scaffolded `platform_kit`, a dependency-free Rust library:

```
Cargo.toml            # edition 2024, rust-version, [lints.rust]/[lints.clippy]
src/lib.rs            # public API: current, Family, Platform
src/platform/mod.rs   # THE ONLY place with #[cfg(...)] dispatch
  info.rs             # shared Family enum + Platform struct
  unix.rs / windows.rs / wasm.rs / fallback.rs
tests/platform.rs
```

The pattern: one thin dispatch module (`platform/mod.rs:8`) re-exports a single `current()` from the module matching `target_family`, with a `fallback` for anything else. Callers use one uniform API, so platform logic stays in four small `cfg` lines instead of scattering `#[cfg]` throughout the crate.

Verified: `cargo test` (4 tests + doctest), `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo check --lib` for `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, and `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` — all clean.

I named the crate `platform_kit` (directory is `work`); rename with `cargo init`/Cargo.toml if you had another name in mind.
